note: Per DL-035 the corpus is a go-to-market instrument and cannot supply engineering constraints. These laws are sourced from JARVIS code ground truth and prior-phase measured findings.

laws.statement: Define the action contract first; let adapters satisfy it. Never let a platform-specific detail reach the planner.
laws.evidence: JARVIS base_adapter.py defines detect_ui/build_plan/verify_action_result as an abstract contract; the 149 fabricated adapters failed because they satisfied the SHAPE of the contract without the substance
laws.failure_case: A contract too abstract to verify produces verify_action_result(): return True — exactly what 144/160 adapters did

laws.statement: An action is not done until independently observed as done. No verification = no action.
laws.evidence: CB-06 144/160 adapters return True unconditionally; docs/adapter_audit.md: first step real, last step missing; ODAV loop already has a verify stage
laws.tradeoff: Verification can cost more than the action itself
laws.failure_case: Verifying the wrong signal (URL changed) instead of the outcome (message sent)

laws.statement: Report inability explicitly and specifically. Never no-op silently.
laws.evidence: resolution_gate.py: "I do not know how to control [platform] yet"; Phase8 R5 shows this is the entry condition to the only virtuous loop
laws.tradeoff: Surfaces incompleteness to users; feels worse in demos
laws.failure_case: Honest failure without a path forward becomes learned helplessness

laws.statement: Safety constraints belong in deterministic code, not in model instructions.
laws.evidence: JARVIS policy_manager.py 338 LOC + permission_engine.py 301 LOC + feature_gate modes; prompts cannot be audited or diffed
laws.failure_case: Policy engine that can be bypassed by the planner defeats its own purpose

laws.statement: Integrate with the incumbent; never attempt to replace the system of record.
laws.evidence: LAW01 (incumbent lock-in GREEN 16 cos); Phase2 0/19 occupy SoR; B2 balancing loop
laws.tradeoff: Ceiling on capability set by the host system
laws.failure_case: Adapter coupling to an unstable UI creates permanent maintenance debt

laws.statement: Autonomy is granted per action type by reversibility and blast radius, never globally.
laws.evidence: feature_gate.py implements OFF/SHADOW/SUGGEST/FORCE; Phase7 F-7.5 human review is liability allocation; B1 loop
laws.failure_case: Uniform autonomy setting forces the whole system to the safety level of its riskiest action

laws.law: Local reasoning for PHI, cloud reasoning for general intelligence
laws.statement: Split inference by data sensitivity, not by capability need.
laws.evidence: JARVIS local-first Ollama; Phase5 arch_on_device_local is the ONE non-converged architecture (7 cos); DPDP/HIPAA localisation pressure
laws.tradeoff: Local models are weaker; hybrid routing adds complexity
laws.failure_case: memory_store.py XOR encryption shows local != secure (CB-08)

laws.statement: One workflow completed end-to-end beats one hundred declared.
laws.evidence: CB-04 3 real/8 defective/149 fabricated; Phase8 R6 flywheel requires completion to generate failure signal
laws.tradeoff: Slower apparent coverage; worse for marketing
laws.failure_case: Depth in the wrong workflow wastes the entire budget

laws.law: State must live in the system, not in the human
laws.statement: If a workflow requires a human to remember it, the software has failed.
laws.evidence: Phase6: bed state "lives in whiteboards and phone calls"; Phase4 break rate 1.00 in ICU/ED/admin
laws.tradeoff: Requires durable state model and reconciliation
laws.failure_case: System state diverging from reality is worse than no state

laws.statement: Every action emits an auditable record of what, why, on whose authority, with what evidence.
laws.evidence: audit_log.py 307 LOC + execution_logger.py 225; LAW07 trust via traceability; Phase7 F-7.4 strengthens under autonomy
laws.failure_case: Logs nobody can query are compliance theatre

laws.law: The orphaned-module rule: unreachable code is not capability
laws.statement: A module nothing imports does not exist. Measure reachability, not lines.
laws.evidence: CB-09 MemoryStore orphaned - imported only by feedback_engine/optimizer which nothing imports; 10515 LOC across 13 concepts but reachability unverified (G-3.4)
laws.failure_case: Counting orphaned LOC as progress - the exact error both G01 panels made

laws.statement: Unmerged work is negative value: it decays, conflicts, and hides the true baseline.
laws.evidence: CB-02 9713 unmerged lines on phase-2-adapter-wiring; default branch = README cosmetics with 7 passing tests vs 325 on the branch
laws.tradeoff: Merging costs time that feels unproductive
laws.failure_case: Merging without CI reproduces the same divergence next cycle
